title: Patch: the living board's standing scene costs a phone less a frame
notes: Issue #3674, after #3633: the idle living board's standing animations cost less a frame. A board Mythic's diorama slice whose motion is one chain of loops draws its still picture on HTML layers the compositor moves (apps/web/src/cards/art/dioramas/lift.ts, artLive.css), a face-down card's breath brightens by an overlay's opacity in place of a filter, a shed step re-renders only the faces and auras its stage changes, and the effects director sheds within a slow moment (R3674000). A card host's pointer readers, its live art and its tilt, read their boxes before either writes (apps/web/src/cards/hostMove.ts), and a Mythic's shimmer in hand paints to one extent, so a moving pointer lays a face's style out once a move and the shimmer no longer re-sorts the page's layers each frame. Under apps/web/src/cards/ (R2529000) the art is the same picture moving the same way: how cards look and play is unchanged.

player.title: Smoother boards on phones
fixes: On slower phones, a full board's moving card art and face-down cards kept every frame busy; they now animate more cheaply, and the effects ease off sooner when a big moment runs slow.
